hooks.name: player_launch_projectile
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no such event; Bukkit's PlayerLaunchProjectile)

rust_summary: A server player launched a projectile item (`native_player_launch_projectile`).
doc_summary: A LAN guest launched a snowball, egg, ender pearl, potion or trident: `native_player_launch_projectile(player, name, item)` runs after the projectile is created. Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_launch_projectile@.
